Perfect — Wed 25 Mar 09:00 CET is confirmed. I'll send an invite and include a calendar file.

A couple notes / workarounds we commonly use with customers when scheduling across regions and DST: 
- Calendly can default to the visitor's timezone but some browser/locale combinations (mobile Safari, older Chrome) misreport the timezone or don't account for upcoming DST shifts.
- If you see the wrong timezone, try: calendar link in an incognito window, or explicitly change the timezone selector in Calendly (bottom left on the booking page).
- Chili Piper tends to be more explicit about TZ and picks the organizer's configured timezone more consistently; if you prefer I can send a Chili Piper booking link.
- Manual invites are the most certain — we'll send an .ics that has the UTC start time baked in so all clients show the same absolute time.
